unmeasured_policy: UNMEASURED fails; the only override is a recorded human entry in OVERRIDES.log naming gate, measured value and reason

gates.name: max dLuma inside shots
gates.target: < 8 (inside a shot, excluding a 0.35 s window after each cut)
gates.source: decoded luma trace (ledger M14), cut windows excluded

gates.name: min type contrast (delivered)
gates.source: WCAG ink vs surrounding pixels, decoded frame

gates.name: cut-point luma delta
gates.source: decoded luma trace at each measured cut (BT.1702 flash threshold)

gates.name: text run inside its canvas
gates.source: core.RecDraw text rects recorded during layer build

revisions.was: max dLuma between ANY two frames < 8
revisions.now: max dLuma INSIDE a shot < 8 (0.35 s cut windows excluded) + G15
revisions.evidence: PROOF-01: the six largest frame-to-frame jumps were 77.2, 72.5, 70.2, 51.7, 47.7, 47.0 and every one landed on a shot boundary; the in-shot mean dLuma was 0.5-2.8. The old target read a hard cut as a strobe.
revisions.why_honest: the strobe risk lives inside a shot; a cut is editing grammar. The cut is now gated separately against the BT.1702 flash threshold, which is STRICTER than the old rule for the frames around a cut.

revisions.was: type ink vs the PLATE's mean luma
revisions.now: type ink vs the surrounding pixels of the DELIVERED frame (WCAG)
revisions.evidence: the proxy scored 2.25:1 on a headline the renderer had already fixed with a scrim, and would have passed type sitting on a blown highlight. Measured on delivered frames the same pack reads 1.17-5.86 across layers.
revisions.why_honest: a proxy cannot see the scrim, the shadow, the bloom or the grade. The gate now measures what a viewer sees.

revisions.was: layer canvas extent vs the safe band
revisions.now: alpha-ink bbox vs the safe band
revisions.evidence: three layer kinds are full-frame canvases with the ink in a corner; the canvas measurement reported 'mark@y0-1080' for a corner mark at y 77-123.
revisions.why_honest: the gate asks where the type sits; the canvas is not the type.

revisions.now: every recorded text run must fit its own canvas
revisions.evidence: read back from the delivered master: the shot-06 gauge label ran 46 px past its card and shipped as 'BEAR SPRA'. Cause: draw_tracked anchors at the LEFT edge and the gauge passed the card's CENTRE.
revisions.why_honest: no exception, no plan error, invisible to every other gate — the only way to catch a silent text clip is to record where text landed. NOTE: G16 validates the builder against the plan, so the picture must be re-rendered whenever the type code changes; G05 samples delivered frames and would still catch an unreadable render.
